summary: The MLOps Data Engineer bridges ML and operations by building robust data infrastructure for production ML workflows and automating model deployment pipelines.
responsibilities: Develop production-ready data pipelines for ML models
Automate ML model training, validation, and deployment pipelines
Ensure data and model versioning, monitoring, and lineage
Collaborate with ML engineers to operationalize AI solutions
Optimize pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability

education: 4–8 years of experience in ML data pipelines or MLOps

skills_required.name: Programming in Python, Scala, or Java
Knowledge of ML lifecycle and MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect)
Strong SQL and data engineering skills
